text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Ah, sorry. I lost my composure.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You see, I just received a thank-you
letter from a
young girl I once saved
from trouble. She says I
was just like a
superhero fighting for justice.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It began when I heard plaintive whimpers
coming
from within a small shed... The
door was rusted
and would not open, so
I delivered a swift punch!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is so rewarding to see the techniques I
trained
so hard prove useful to others. I
shall continue to
strive for mastery!
